files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A footer with the brand, a tagline, groups of links and the copyright. Axes: layout (columns: brand above,
  equal columns per group, row: the brand, the group names and the copyright in one row), signup mode (none,
  first: a sign-up above the links), status mode (none, show: a live status pill), density. The live status
  itself is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { FooterSignup, FooterStatus } from "./sitemap-footer.types";
import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";

export type SitemapFooterProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  tagline: string;
  copyright: string;
  groups: MegaGroup[];
  signup?: FooterSignup;
  status?: FooterStatus;
  id?: string;
  layout?: "columns" | "row" | "card";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Form from "../compose/Form.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import Label from "../compose/Label.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import FooterCard from "../components/footer-card.vue";
import FooterColumns from "../components/footer-columns.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  tagline,
  copyright,
  groups,
  signup,
  status,
  id = "footer",
  layout = "columns",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SitemapFooterProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <FooterCard
    v-if="((layout as string) === 'card')"
    :label="label"
    :brand="brand"
    :groups="groups"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  />
  <Block v-else
    tag="footer"
    class="mt-12 border-t border-border"
    data-testid="site-footer"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'flex flex-col gap-8',
        (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-6' : 'py-12')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Stack v-if="(signup?.mode === 'first')" gap="4" class="max-w-md" data-testid="signup">
        <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
          {{ signup?.title }}
        </Title>
        <Form method="dialog" :class="cn('w-full max-w-md', (false ? 'mx-auto' : ''))" data-testid="email-form">
          <Label :for="tpl('{0}-email', id)" class="sr-only">
            {{ signup?.label }}
          </Label>
          <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
            <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-testid="field" />
            <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" data-testid="submit">
              {{ signup?.submit }}
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Form>
      </Stack>
      <Box
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'columns')"
        class="flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row md:items-start md:gap-12"
        data-slot="footer-top"
      >
        <Stack gap="2" class="md:w-64 md:shrink-0">
          <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ brand }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tagline }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Box class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <FooterColumns :label="label" :groups="groups" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
        </Box>
      </Box>
      <Group v-else gap="6" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="base" weight="bold">
          {{ brand }}
        </Text>
        <NavBlock
          v-if="((groups?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
          :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', label, landmarkLabel)) : label)"
        >
          <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
            <MenuEntry v-for="g in groups" :key="g.id" :href="g.href" class="text-sm" testid="group">
              {{ g.title }}
            </MenuEntry>
          </Group>
        </NavBlock>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap border-t border-border pt-6">
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ copyright }}
        </Text>
        <Pill v-if="(status?.mode === 'show')" tone="green" icon="circle-check">
          {{ status?.label }}
        </Pill>
      </Group>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
